translations.web: I find then the law that, to me, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
translations.bsb: So this is the principle I have discovered: When I want to do good, evil is right there with me.
translations.kjv: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
translations.asv: I find then the law, that, to me who would do good, evil is present.
